foresightGenome.goal: Construct and independently check a consenting, funded roster-and-care arrangement.
foresightGenome.successMetric: A fresh synthetic case gains a funded accepted arrangement while staffing, full care, qualifications, consent and finite fallback remain intact; conventional parity and failures stay visible.
foresightGenome.thesis: Consenting roster changes across employers can concentrate fragmented care demand into a funded qualified opening. A coupled commitment instrument preserves production, individual choices and finite fallback obligations. Existing flexible-care and consortium services are strong prior art; the contribution is a tested bounded construction, not a claim of historical firstness.
foresightGenome.title: Joint roster commitments that make a care cohort fundable
